counting: Unicode characters including punctuation, matching the owner's outlier report

replacements.hanzi: 学校离地铁站很近，学生常坐地铁上课。
replacements.pinyin: Xuéxiào lí dìtiězhàn hěn jìn, xuéshēng cháng zuò dìtiě shàngkè.
replacements.english: The school is close to the subway station, and students often take the subway to class.

replacements.hanzi: 来中国后，我受到很多帮助。
replacements.pinyin: Lái Zhōngguó hòu, wǒ shòudào hěn duō bāngzhù.
replacements.english: I received a lot of help after coming to China.

replacements.hanzi: 坐火车便宜，再说她也不赶时间。
replacements.pinyin: Zuò huǒchē piányi, zàishuō tā yě bù gǎn shíjiān.
replacements.english: Taking the train is cheap; besides, she is not in a hurry.

replacements.hanzi: 他称没收到通知，你问问他。
replacements.pinyin: Tā chēng méi shōudào tōngzhī, nǐ wènwen tā.
replacements.english: He claims he did not get the notice. Ask him.

replacements.hanzi: 我们简化步骤，从而省了时间。
replacements.pinyin: Wǒmen jiǎnhuà bùzhòu, cóng'ér shěng le shíjiān.
replacements.english: We simplified the steps and thereby saved time.

replacements.hanzi: 反正时间还够，不妨再检查一次。
replacements.pinyin: Fǎnzhèng shíjiān hái gòu, bùfáng zài jiǎnchá yí cì.
replacements.english: There is still enough time anyway, so we might as well check once more.

replacements.hanzi: 做蛋糕时，蛋清和蛋黄要分离吗？
replacements.pinyin: Zuò dàngāo shí, dànqīng hé dànhuáng yào fēnlí ma?
replacements.english: Should the egg white and yolk be separated when making a cake?

replacements.hanzi: 阳光透过窗户，室内光线充足。
replacements.pinyin: Yángguāng tòuguò chuānghu, shìnèi guāngxiàn chōngzú.
replacements.english: Sunlight streams through the window, filling the room with light.

replacements.hanzi: “哈，终于解出来了！”老师笑道。
replacements.pinyin: "Hā, zhōngyú jiě chūlái le!" Lǎoshī xiào dào.
replacements.english: "Ha, it is finally solved!" the teacher said with a smile.

replacements.hanzi: 列车即将到站，请准备下车。
replacements.pinyin: Lièchē jíjiāng dào zhàn, qǐng zhǔnbèi xià chē.
replacements.english: The train will arrive shortly. Please get ready to get off.

replacements.hanzi: 他急忙跑出去了，出什么事了？
replacements.pinyin: Tā jímáng pǎo chūqù le, chū shénme shì le?
replacements.english: He hurried out. Did something happen?

replacements.hanzi: 这部纪录片分六集，介绍各地传统工艺。
replacements.pinyin: Zhè bù jìlùpiàn fēn liù jí, jièshào gèdì chuántǒng gōngyì.
replacements.english: This six-part documentary introduces traditional crafts from different regions.

replacements.hanzi: 考得好，爸爸会奖励你什么？
replacements.pinyin: Kǎo de hǎo, bàba huì jiǎnglì nǐ shénme?
replacements.english: What will Dad reward you with if you do well on the exam?

replacements.hanzi: 我建议选较简单的方案。
replacements.pinyin: Wǒ jiànyì xuǎn jiào jiǎndān de fāng'àn.
replacements.english: I suggest choosing the simpler plan.

replacements.hanzi: 有些动物既能在水中生活，也能在陆地活动。
replacements.pinyin: Yǒuxiē dòngwù jì néng zài shuǐ zhōng shēnghuó, yě néng zài lùdì huódòng.
replacements.english: Some animals can live in water and also move about on land.

replacements.hanzi: 报告指出了政策目标与实际效果的矛盾。
replacements.pinyin: Bàogào zhǐchū le zhèngcè mùbiāo yǔ shíjì xiàoguǒ de máodùn.
replacements.english: The report highlighted a contradiction between policy goals and actual outcomes.

replacements.hanzi: 道路维修期间，居民没法儿开车出门。
replacements.pinyin: Dàolù wéixiū qījiān, jūmín méi fǎr kāichē chūmén.
replacements.english: Residents cannot drive out while the road is being repaired.

replacements.hanzi: 警方提醒居民，谨防被骗走钱财。
replacements.pinyin: Jǐngfāng tíxǐng jūmín, jǐnfáng bèi piàn zǒu qiáncái.
replacements.english: Police reminded residents to guard against being swindled out of money.

replacements.hanzi: 别动桌子，会破坏原来的布局。
replacements.pinyin: Bié dòng zhuōzi, huì pòhuài yuánlái de bùjú.
replacements.english: Do not move the tables; it will spoil the original layout.

replacements.hanzi: 我介绍一下计划及其主要目标。
replacements.pinyin: Wǒ jièshào yíxià jìhuà jí qí zhǔyào mùbiāo.
replacements.english: Let me introduce the plan and its main goals.

replacements.hanzi: 他从照片中认出了失散多年的朋友。
replacements.pinyin: Tā cóng zhàopiàn zhōng rènchū le shīsàn duō nián de péngyou.
replacements.english: He recognized a friend he had lost touch with years ago in a photograph.

replacements.hanzi: 进实验室需戴手套，大家注意。
replacements.pinyin: Jìn shíyànshì xū dài shǒutào, dàjiā zhùyì.
replacements.english: Please note that gloves are required in the laboratory.

replacements.hanzi: 要不是及时采取措施，损失会更大。
replacements.pinyin: Yàobúshì jíshí cǎiqǔ cuòshī, sǔnshī huì gèng dà.
replacements.english: Without timely action, the losses would have been greater.

replacements.hanzi: 由此可见，新办法确实有效。
replacements.pinyin: Yóucǐ kějiàn, xīn bànfǎ quèshí yǒuxiào.
replacements.english: This shows that the new method really works.

replacements.hanzi: 两家公司签署协议，由此建立长期合作。
replacements.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī qiānshǔ xiéyì, yóucǐ jiànlì chángqī hézuò.
replacements.english: The two companies signed an agreement, establishing long-term cooperation.

replacements.hanzi: “事情搞糟了，得重新安排。”他说。
replacements.pinyin: "Shìqing gǎo zāo le, děi chóngxīn ānpái." Tā shuō.
replacements.english: "Things have gone wrong; we need to rearrange them," he said.

replacements.hanzi: 游客大增，酒店房间不够了。
replacements.pinyin: Yóukè dà zēng, jiǔdiàn fángjiān bú gòu le.
replacements.english: Tourist numbers have surged, and there are not enough hotel rooms.

replacements.hanzi: 五年来，该校学生由两千人增至三千人。
replacements.pinyin: Wǔ nián lái, gāi xiào xuéshēng yóu liǎng qiān rén zēng zhì sān qiān rén.
replacements.english: Over five years, the school's student numbers rose from two thousand to three thousand.

replacements.hanzi: 运输成本增加，部分商品涨价了。
replacements.pinyin: Yùnshū chéngběn zēngjiā, bùfen shāngpǐn zhǎngjià le.
replacements.english: Higher transport costs have caused some goods to rise in price.

replacements.hanzi: 报名时间是周一至周五。
replacements.pinyin: Bàomíng shíjiān shì zhōuyī zhì zhōuwǔ.
replacements.english: Registration runs from Monday to Friday.

replacements.hanzi: 公司准备了足够的资金，保障项目推进。
replacements.pinyin: Gōngsī zhǔnbèi le zúgòu de zījīn, bǎozhàng xiàngmù tuījìn.
replacements.english: The company set aside sufficient funds to keep the project moving forward.

replacements.hanzi: 这项研究最初仅涉及三个城市，后来扩大了。
replacements.pinyin: Zhè xiàng yánjiū zuìchū jǐn shèjí sān ge chéngshì, hòulái kuòdà le.
replacements.english: The study initially covered only three cities and later expanded.
